Game Overview

In Puzzimals, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your puzzle prowess with adorable animal companions. Slide through charming, funny creatures like capybaras and guinea pigs, overcoming delightful challenges at every turn. Can you solve the cute chaos and reunite them all?

How to Play

Each session of Puzzimals follows a consistent rhythm. Unleash your puzzle prowess with adorable animal companions! Slide through charming, funny creatures like capybaras and guinea pigs, overcoming delightful challenges at every turn. Can you solve the cute chaos and reunite them all?

Puzzimals is a free jigsaw puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

The goal is to unleash your puzzle prowess with adorable animal companions. Slide through charming, funny creatures like capybaras and guinea pigs, overcoming delightful challenges at every turn.
